== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Come With Me (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Come With Me (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, each as cut from its sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>c6e625c02396f4ae15f260ae3187b693c7cebf00</code>.
